title: Katie Bowles
text:
As a data enthusiast, I build dashboards, reports, and automate data tools that turn complex data into clear and actionable insights for all levels of management and reporting.
I’m a Financial Applications Business Analyst in Connecticut, where I help lead digital transformation across the finance and accounting organizations. I studied Data Science at Worcester Polytechnic Institute and am now pursuing a Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University.
In my spare time, I enjoy exploring new data visualization techniques for personal projects- when I am not unwinding with a good book or on outdoor adventures.

title: Katie Bowles
text:
What I Work On

Dashboards and Reporting. Interactive and exploratory developement in Power BI and Looker Studio that stakeholders use to track and understand KPIs.
Financial Systems. Oracle support, SQL querying, and billing support, plus ensuring accurate, timely, and reliable information for decision-making.
Data Analysis and Modeling. Python, R, SQL, and DAX for extracting, analyzing, and modeling large datasets.
Controls. Support for SOX control processes and narrative development.

title: Katie Bowles
text:
Highlights
I recently completed developement of a labor detail dashboard that brings together six years of data for more than 30,000 employees. It lets management at every level spot trends faster and make better decisions to optimize production and delivery while supporting more effective analysis in workforce planning and resource allocation.

title: Data Visualization Analysis Across Cultures
text:
Overview
This project at Worcester Polytechnic Institute examined data visualizations created across non-WEIRD cultures, meaning cultures outside the Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic populations that most research draws from.

title: Data Visualization Analysis Across Cultures
text:
What I did

Used APIs and algorithms to collect data visualizations from a range of cultures and analyze them.
Scraped color and language information from the collected visualizations and their associated websites using Python.
